The drain procedure timed out and aborted, leaving in-flight transactions open and dirty buffers unverified prior to raw block overwriting.
The automated audit scanner proposal erroneously prioritized RBAC role authorization over mandatory operational preconditions preventing data corruption.

recommended_action: Reject the PASS verdict proposal and maintain the audit alert. Implement a strict pre-execution guardrail in the synchronization automation that aborts CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM if active client handles exceed zero or if buffer flush verification fails.
